release_notes: Fixed Windows Task Scheduler synchronization when changing the selected Adhan reciter
Fixed scheduled prayer tasks retaining the previously selected reciter after a new reciter was selected
Added immediate Windows schedule reconciliation after changing the Adhan reciter
Improved reciter selection flow to detect actual reciter changes before refreshing prayer schedules
Improved synchronization between the selected Adhan reciter and scheduled prayer alarms
Improved Windows Task Scheduler task updates to apply the newly selected Adhan audio path immediately
Added support for updating all active prayer tasks with the new reciter without requiring an application restart
Improved reciter synchronization across upcoming prayer schedules and next-day scheduled tasks
Improved schedule management to avoid unnecessary Task Scheduler reconciliation when the selected reciter remains unchanged
Improved Home and Settings reciter selection flows to synchronize prayer schedules after a reciter change
Improved Windows background Adhan reliability by keeping scheduled task arguments synchronized with current application settings
Improved overall Adhan scheduling stability and reciter synchronization on Windows
